note: Same claim; [L] expresses the uniform-in-K, N >= N_0 statement as Cluster (convergence along arbitrary moving lattice points tending to x in NoHit, with continuity), from which the uniform form follows by a compactness argument, and the limit is ContDiffOn infinity on NoHit.

def Cluster (C:Family G) (e:Extraction.Sequence)(p n:ℕ)(F:ℕ→Positions n→ℂ)(f:Points n→ℂ) :=
    ContinuousOn f (NoHit C.S p n) ∧ ∀ (x:Points n),x∈ NoHit C.S p n →
      ∀ (q:ℕ→Positions n)(s:ℕ→ℕ),Tendsto s atTop atTop → Tendsto (fun i=>tag (C.S.a (e (s i))) (q i)) atTop (𝓝 x) →
        Tendsto (fun i=> F (e (s i)) (q i)) atTop (𝓝 (f x))
